# HexPiece 2.2.3

The abilities panel on the left is regrouped as you asked. Nothing here has been tested in game yet; the build's checks and tests pass.

## The abilities panel
- **Your fighting style and Haki share one panel**, whatever you are doing: the style's moves (dim while combat mode is off, with R
  to turn it on), then Armament, Observation and the Conqueror's quick slots, with their keys.
- **The devil fruit has its own panel, alone**: its moves on your keys (locked ones dim with the mastery they need, recharging ones
  with the seconds left), and R to go back to your style and Haki.

## Unchanged
The network protocol is the same as 2.2.1.
